class_ids_and_names_source: Exact native Zenodo nrPDB-GO_annot.tsv header; ordered global vocabulary, never selected from test-positive labels
closure_definition: obonet OBO graph child-to-parent reachability: networkx.descendants(go_graph, go_id), plus the term itself, excluding GO:0008150/GO:0003674/GO:0005575. Source does not explicitly filter edge relation types; all relations parsed into that graph are traversed. Global class filtering uses >49 and <=5000 annotated proteins before released splits.
exact_blocker: Pinned DeepFRI data_collection.sh downloads unversioned http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/go/go-basic.obo. No OBO file, historical release identifier or checksum appears in pinned repository tree or native Zenodo archive member listings. Filename date 2019.06.18 alone does not identify the exact ontology bytes.
affects: Regenerating historical annotation closure or adding ontology-based output score propagation; native supplied-target AP/Fmax does not need a newly reconstructed graph.
next_step: Obtain author OBO/checksum or explicit release identity if annotation/graph reproduction is required. Do not substitute current GO or an inferred nearby archived release while claiming exact native equivalence.
